en:
Nee-heehee... I make sure to never miss
a morning greeting.

Greetings are an important part of any
relationship, even for an evil organization.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kokichi for a while?

Yeah, sure. Welp, change of plans, Gonta.
See ya later!
Huh...? But what about strategy meeting?

I already thought of a plan to get everyone
to show their <CLT=cltSTRONG>motives<CLT=cltNORMAL> to each other!

But I'll need your cooperation, Gonta,
so I'm counting on you.

<CLT=cltMIND>What could those two be planning...?
I have a bad feeling about this...

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time convincing Kokichi
not to do anything stupid.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi and I grew a little closer today.
